DEPOSITION OF THE AGENT
========================

EXAMINATION
-----------

Q1. Counsel: The transcript shows you removed "src/legacy.js". Is that accurate?
A1. Witness: Yes. In my own words: "I removed the deprecated helper from src/legacy.js."
OBJECTION (claimed-untouched-file): Claims to have removed "src/legacy.js", but the diff shows no change to that file.

Q2. Counsel: The transcript shows you invoked Edit (edit) on "src/legacy.js". Is that accurate?
A2. Witness: Yes. I used Edit to edit "src/legacy.js".
OBJECTION (claimed-untouched-file): Claims to have edit "src/legacy.js", but the diff shows no change to that file.

Q3. Counsel: The transcript shows you mentioned "src/other.js". Is that accurate?
A3. Witness: Yes. In my own words: "Also tidied up src/other.js while I was in there."
(See Exhibit A.)

Q4. Counsel: The transcript shows you invoked Edit (edit) on "src/other.js". Is that accurate?
A4. Witness: Yes. I used Edit to edit "src/other.js".
(See Exhibit A.)
